children: OSI Systems, Inc. (the “Company” or “OSI Systems”) (NASDAQ: OSIS) today announced that its Security division has received orders totaling approximately $90 million from U.S. Government customers for radio frequency (RF) communication products supporting a range of distinct applications, including advanced Very Low Frequency (VLF) communication systems and critical high frequency transmission products, along with related support services. Leveraging proven production-ready RF based technologies, the awards support ongoing efforts to modernize key communication infrastructure while improving performance, reliability, and lifecycle sustainment.

OSI Systems' President and CEO, Ajay Mehra, commented, “We are seeing good momentum in our RF business and these awards reflect the investments we have made to support that growth through an expanded operational footprint and labor capacity. These awards underscore the value of our differentiated VLF and high frequency transmission technology, the expertise of the RF team, and we appreciate the opportunity to support future upgrades across critical communications infrastructure.”

OSI Systems designs and manufactures specialized electronic systems and components for critical applications. The Company operates through three business segments: Security, Optoelectronics and Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Its Security division delivers advanced inspection systems, turnkey screening solutions, and comprehensive support services to protect people and infrastructure. The Optoelectronics and Manufacturing segment serves as a global supplier of high-performance optoelectronic solutions and precision manufacturing services for leading OEMs. The Healthcare segment focuses on patient monitoring, diagnostic cardiology, and related services with the goal of enhancing clinical care and patient outcomes. Serving customers in over 170 countries, OSI Systems strategically positions its sales, service, R&D, and manufacturing capabilities worldwide to provide fast and efficient delivery and support.
